item.title: Track B, Ep 4 — The Commercial Challenge
item.description: Revenue channels, Economics 2.0, competitive threats, adoption barriers, and what the commercial architecture needs to contain.

item.title: Track B, Ep 3 — From Architecture to Deployment
item.description: The institutional evidence base: production versus pilot across UBS, Amundi, J.P. Morgan, Swift, DTCC, Euroclear, and CRE.

item.title: Track B, Ep 2 — Becoming the Standard
item.description: 2017 to 2022: DeFi Summer, Total Value Secured, the 2021 whitepaper, Swift, CCIP, and the competitive picture.

item.title: Track B, Ep 1 — The Problem Before the Product
item.description: Chainlink's origins: SmartContract.com, the Cornell collaboration, the 2017 token launch, and LINK's regulatory status.

item.title: Track A, Supplemental — The 2017 Whitepaper Deep Dive
item.description: Design principles, SGX confidentiality, TLS-N, and the off-chain computation vision in the original Chainlink whitepaper.

item.title: Track A, Ep 5 — Why TradFi Needs DeFi
item.description: Synthesis: why traditional finance is becoming DeFi's largest customer, and the revenue-to-value gap.

item.title: Track A, Ep 4 — The Bridge Standard
item.description: Cross-chain interoperability, CCIP, and why the standard-setter wins disproportionately.

item.title: Track A, Ep 3 — The Ten Trillion Wave
item.description: Real-world asset tokenisation: what it means, which asset classes move first, and how to read the market-size forecasts.

item.title: Track A, Ep 2 — The Connectivity Gap
item.description: The oracle problem: why blockchains cannot see the outside world, and how decentralised oracle networks bridge it.

item.title: Track A, Ep 1 — The Architecture of Trustless Finance
item.description: What DeFi is, how smart contracts work, and what 'permissionless' and 'trustless' actually mean.
